item.title: St. Louis County Jail inmate death
item.description: On January 25, 2026, Darrin John Tiessen (DOB: 04/16/1990) was booked into the St. Louis County Jail by the Sheriff’s Office for an active arrest warrant. The warrant was issued by the Sixth Judicial District Court after Mr. Tiessen failed to appear in a previous court hearing. item.title: Bigfork Schools Receive MnDOT Golden Snow Boot Award
item.description: Bigfork, MN — Bigfork Schools have been named the winner of the MnDOT Golden Snow Boot Award, an annual recognition presented by the Minnesota Safe Routes to School (MnSRTS) program.
